Guideline: Use <TransitionGroup> with v-move for Neighbor Knockback
Description: Vue's <TransitionGroup> automatically applies FLIP transitions via the -move class when items are inserted, deleted, or reordered.
Do: Add position: absolute to .list-leave-active so remaining siblings smoothly glide into place via .list-move
Don't: Omit position: absolute on leave-active (causes siblings to snap abruptly only after the fade-out finishes)
Code Bad: .list-leave-active { transition: opacity 300ms; } /* Siblings jump at end */
